HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   C. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

6. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

9. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.

10. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.

11. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.

13. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   B. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.

14. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
